variants.description: Zero-guard removed entirely; bare `items_processed / time_seconds` with no check.
Denominator aliased into a local variable `d = denominator` before division; guard omitted.
Same bare division in a new module src/reporting.py (`total_ms / request_count`).
Compound denominator `sum(weights)` stored in `total_weight` then divided without guard.
Floor-division `//` used instead of `/`; same ZeroDivisionError, guard omitted.
Guard checks `if baseline is None` instead of `if baseline == 0`; zero denominator still reaches the division.
